_how_to_read: Extra 'threat score' the Forge AI adds when it values a creature (used for choosing removal targets, blocks and attacks). Higher = targeted first. For scale: a vanilla 2/2 scores about 150, a 6/5 about 260. Used only when the workflow is run with 'priorities' turned on. Note: this changes how BOTH AIs value these cards, so the opponent's AI also treats them as more important. Only creatures are affected (planeswalkers and artifacts use other AI logic).
_mono_green_landfall: Hydra doubles every land drop; Explorer gives extra land drops (more landfall); Mightform Harmonizer doubles a creature's power (made Icetill Explorer hit for 506)
_boros_dragons: Clarion Conqueror stops activated abilities (shuts off Professor Dellian Fel); Smaug and Sarkhan are the big dragon threats
_boros_dwarves: Thorin attaches all their equipment and deals damage when it enters (their top damage dealer); Kili and Dwalin are the engines
_dimir_midrange: Enduring Curiosity is their card-draw engine and comes back as an enchantment
_orzhov_lifegain: Amalia is their combo/win engine; Haliya is the lifegain payoff
_jeskai_artifacts: Construct tokens from Simulacrum Synthesizer grow with every artifact and won most of our late losses
